tell_vi: Prompt toàn từ khoá chất lượng: 8k, masterpiece, award-winning
tell_en: The prompt is a stack of quality words rather than a description of a scene
look_where: The prompt itself: count how many words describe light, position and material versus how many are adjectives about quality
why_it_happens: These tags were how 2022-era diffusion models were steered. Current models read described scenes, so the tags spend attention without adding information — and they pull toward the average of everything ever tagged that way, which is the definition of slop
fix: Delete every quality adjective. Write where the light comes from, where the camera is, what the material does. A prompt that names one light source beats a prompt with twelve quality words

tell_vi: Chèn tên nghệ sĩ hoặc studio để mượn phong cách
tell_en: A living artist, studio or campaign is named to borrow its style
look_where: Any proper noun in the prompt that is a person, studio, magazine or campaign
why_it_happens: It is the cheapest way to move output, so it is the first thing people reach for. It is also a rights problem and it makes every output look like everyone else's output
fix: Name the technique instead of the person: the light shape, the lens behaviour, the palette, the era of the process. Same control, no borrowed identity

tell_vi: Lụa, satin, khói, cánh hoa bay không có lý do
tell_en: Silk, satin, smoke or petals appear with no reason to be there
look_where: The empty parts of the frame — filler always grows in the space the brief left open
why_it_happens: Image models fill negative space by default, and drapery is the highest-probability filler
fix: State what occupies the reserved area: nothing. Then verify on the render, because a reserve the scene filled is not a reserve

tell_vi: Bệ đá cẩm thạch, bục pastel không liên quan sản phẩm
tell_en: A marble slab or pastel pedestal the product has no relationship with
look_where: Under and behind the product
why_it_happens: It is the most common surface in commercial-image training data, so it is what you get when the brief does not name a surface
fix: Name the surface the product actually sits on in its real life. A worn counter outperforms a marble plinth for anything under premium
applies_to: packshot-white packshot-context cosmetic-bottle jewelry-macro snack-packaged texture-swatch packaging-concept

tell_vi: Loé sáng, glow không có nguồn sáng nào tạo ra được
tell_en: A flare or glow no light source in the scene could cast
look_where: Trace every bright artefact back to a source you named. If you cannot, it is invented
why_it_happens: Glow reads as production value in training data, so it is added regardless of physics
fix: Name the sources and their positions. Then reject any highlight whose direction disagrees with them

tell_vi: Bóng đổ ngược hướng sáng
tell_en: Shadows that point the wrong way for the stated light
look_where: Contact shadows under objects, and cast shadows on the background — they often disagree with each other
why_it_happens: Each element is plausible on its own; consistency across the frame is not enforced
fix: One named key direction, and a QA pass that checks every shadow against it. This is the fastest single check for a fake frame

tell_vi: Vật thể không tựa vào gì, thiếu bóng tiếp xúc
tell_en: An object resting on nothing, with no contact shadow
look_where: Where the object meets the surface, at pixel level
why_it_happens: Contact shadow is small and easy to lose, and its absence reads as wrong without the viewer knowing why
fix: Require a contact shadow in the brief and check it at 100 percent zoom before approving
applies_to: packshot-white packshot-context cosmetic-bottle jewelry-macro snack-packaged electronics-hero shoe-hero packaging-concept size-comparison apparel-flatlay unboxing-frame ingredient-deconstruct texture-swatch

tell_vi: Da nhựa, không lỗ chân lông
tell_en: Poreless plastic skin
look_where: Cheeks, forehead, the bridge of the nose, and the transition at the jaw
why_it_happens: Retouching bias in training data plus every upscaler smoothing on the way out
fix: Require pores, fine hair, uneven tone and one asymmetry. Reject a prettier face; the face was not the product
applies_to: apparel-on-model beauty-closeup customer-using fashion-editorial founder-portrait skincare-on-skin staff-at-work team-group testimonial-frame ugc-selfie

tell_vi: Bàn tay sai: sáu ngón, ngón trùng, khớp ngược
tell_en: Hands that fail — six fingers, duplicated thumbs, impossible joints
look_where: Every hand, every finger, every grip; and whether the grip could apply the force shown
why_it_happens: Hands have high articulation and low pixel area, which is the worst combination for a generator
fix: Prefer hands-only frames where the hand is large in frame so errors are visible, and always render-check. Never approve a hand from a thumbnail
applies_to: hands-only-demo unboxing-frame coffee-pour grill-smoke hotpot-share ugc-selfie skincare-on-skin customer-using staff-at-work apparel-on-model fashion-editorial founder-portrait team-group market-stall delivery-motorbike

tell_vi: Đồ ăn bóng như sáp, nước dùng đục
tell_en: Food with a waxy sheen, or broth rendered opaque
look_where: Broth surface, sauce, cooked greens, meat grain
why_it_happens: Food-styling images in training data are gelled and sprayed, so the model has learned gel as the default finish
fix: Name the material behaviour: translucent broth with fat rings, wet separate noodles, cut and slightly bruised herbs. Material behaviour is where food images stop looking generated
applies_to: dish-delivery bowl-counter banh-mi-section grill-smoke hotpot-share snack-packaged coffee-pour ingredient-deconstruct

tell_vi: Hạt nước đọng đều tăm tắp
tell_en: Condensation beads in a perfectly even pattern
look_where: The glass surface: real beads vary in size and only some have run
why_it_happens: Texture is generated as a pattern rather than as a physical process
fix: Ask for uneven beading with two or three run tracks. Same for rain, dust and rust

tell_vi: Khói bốc lên cân đối như hiệu ứng
tell_en: Smoke or steam rising as a symmetric plume
look_where: The column shape: real smoke is thin, tilted, and broken by air
why_it_happens: Smoke is drawn as decoration rather than as a fluid moving through a room
fix: Say thin, directional, broken, tilted by the room's own air. And use less of it than feels right

tell_vi: Giọt bắn đóng băng giữa không trung
tell_en: A frozen splash crown or droplets suspended mid-air
look_where: Any liquid in motion
why_it_happens: High-speed advertising photography is over-represented in training data
fix: Unless you are actually selling the splash, remove it. A slightly blurred stream reads real; a frozen crown reads rendered

tell_vi: Kính, chai có hai vệt sáng đối nghịch
tell_en: Glass with two competing specular highlights
look_where: The vertical edges of bottles, jars and screens
why_it_happens: Each side is lit plausibly and no single lighting solution is enforced
fix: One named strip source and a black card on the other side. This is why glass renders look fake when everything else is right

tell_vi: Chữ, logo, giá do model tự sinh
tell_en: Text, logo, price, or signage the model invented
look_where: Every glyph in the frame, including background signage and packaging panels
why_it_happens: Text is treated as texture, so it is generated at the same confidence as a shadow
fix: Ask for no text at all, and set every word in layout afterwards. A rendered price is an invented price, and someone will print it

tell_vi: Ảnh 'sau' được chiếu sáng đẹp hơn ảnh 'trước'
tell_en: The after frame is better lit than the before frame
look_where: Light direction, exposure, white balance and crop across the pair
why_it_happens: The two frames are generated or shot independently, so nothing holds them identical
fix: Identical camera, light, exposure and crop; change only the claimed thing. Otherwise the pair is a lighting change presented as a result

tell_vi: Ảnh 'khách tự chụp' nhưng bố cục và ánh sáng quá đẹp
tell_en: UGC-style creative that is well composed and well lit
look_where: Composition, exposure, grade, and whether the frame is level
why_it_happens: The generator optimises for pleasing images, and UGC works because it is not pleasing
fix: Ask for phone-camera behaviour: off-centre, slightly off-level, mixed colour temperature, sensor noise, mild motion blur. A polished UGC frame performs worse than an honest ad

tell_vi: Cả bộ ảnh không có hạt, quá sạch
tell_en: Every frame in the set is perfectly clean
look_where: Flat areas: skies, walls, backgrounds
why_it_happens: Denoisers and upscalers remove grain at every stage
fix: Keep a small amount of real sensor grain, and keep it consistent across the set. Zero grain across a whole campaign reads as generated even when each frame passes on its own

tell_vi: Không gian đẹp nhưng không có ai
tell_en: A beautiful interior with nobody in it
look_where: Whether the space shows use: things on tables, chairs pulled out, wear on surfaces
why_it_happens: Empty rooms are easier to generate and easier to approve
fix: Put people in it at real distances, and leave the used objects. An empty room reads as closed whatever the caption says

tell_vi: Phố bị dọn sạch, mặt tiền bị làm thẳng
tell_en: The street has been emptied and the facade software-straightened
look_where: Verticals, neighbours, pavement, wires
why_it_happens: Correction tools default to on and empty is easier
fix: Keep verticals straight by camera position rather than by warping, and keep the neighbours. A storefront frame exists to make the place findable

tell_vi: Câu nào cũng dùng gạch ngang, cùng một nhịp
tell_en: Every sentence carries an em dash, at the same point in the sentence
look_where: Read three sentences in a row aloud and listen for the same shape repeating
why_it_happens: It is a strong rhythmic default and nothing pushes back on repetition
fix: Vary sentence length deliberately: one short, one long, one fragment. Rhythm is the fastest tell in copy, faster than vocabulary

tell_vi: Mọi thứ đều liệt kê ba ý
tell_en: Everything arrives in threes
look_where: Count list lengths across the whole document
why_it_happens: Three is the most rhetorically satisfying count, so it becomes every count
fix: Let some lists be two and some be five. Three is correct when there are three things

tell_vi: Mẫu câu 'không chỉ… mà còn…' lặp lại
tell_en: The not-just-X-but-Y construction, repeatedly
look_where: Search the draft for the construction and count
why_it_happens: It manufactures contrast without needing a fact, which is exactly why it is empty
fix: Replace each with the specific fact the contrast was standing in for. If there is no fact, the sentence had no content

tell_vi: Tính từ thay cho bằng chứng: đỉnh, tuyệt vời, chất lượng cao
tell_en: Adjectives standing in for evidence: premium, exceptional, high-quality
look_where: Every adjective: ask what number, source or observation it replaced
why_it_happens: Adjectives are free and evidence is expensive
fix: One specific number, one named source, or one thing the reader can verify — per claim. Delete the adjective afterwards; it will not be missed

tell_vi: Từ vựng máy: delve, tapestry, landscape, leverage, unlock
tell_en: Machine vocabulary: delve, tapestry, navigate the landscape, leverage, unlock, elevate
look_where: Nouns and verbs at the start of sentences and section headings
why_it_happens: These words are over-represented in generated text and now read as a signature
fix: Use the word the customer would use. In Vietnamese the equivalent tell is formal compound vocabulary where a shop owner would use one plain verb

tell_vi: Đoạn nào cũng dài bằng nhau
tell_en: Every paragraph is the same length
look_where: Squint at the page and look at the block shapes
why_it_happens: Uniform generation length, with no editorial pressure toward unevenness
fix: Let one paragraph be a single line. Uneven blocks are the visual signature of someone deciding what matters

tell_vi: Rào trước đón sau: có thể, thường, nhìn chung
tell_en: Stacked hedges: may, often, generally, in many cases
look_where: Any sentence with two or more qualifiers
why_it_happens: Hedging is safe when a fact is unknown, and unknown facts are common
fix: Either find the fact or state plainly that it is unknown and who could answer it. A labelled unknown is useful; a hedge is not

tell_vi: Kết bài bằng câu mời chung chung, không phải CTA
tell_en: The piece ends with a warm generic invitation instead of an action
look_where: The last two sentences
why_it_happens: Generated text closes by summarising and being pleasant
fix: End with one action, its cost in effort, and what happens next. If there is no next action, the piece did not need to exist

tell_vi: Bố cục rõ ràng là template điền vào
tell_en: The artefact reads as a template someone filled in
look_where: Count typefaces, weights, and whether every element sits at a default size
why_it_happens: Defaults are invisible to the person choosing them
fix: Change real geometry, not just colour and words: margin, pitch, size ratio, grid. Three options that differ only in colour are one option wearing three hats

tell_vi: Mọi thứ căn giữa
tell_en: Everything is centre-aligned
look_where: Left edges: if no two elements share one, there is no structure
why_it_happens: Centring never looks broken, so it is the safe default at every step
fix: Give the page one strong left edge and let one element deliberately break it. Centring is a decision that should be made once, not seventeen times

tell_vi: Xuất mọi format cho mọi kênh cho đủ số lượng
tell_en: Every format exported for every channel, to fill a number
look_where: The asset list: how many assets carry a message no other asset carries
why_it_happens: Volume is easy to produce and easy to report
fix: Select the minimum useful set and say which ones were dropped and why. Twelve assets carrying three messages is three assets and nine copies

tell_vi: Kế hoạch là danh sách chiến thuật, không có giả thuyết
tell_en: The plan is a list of tactics with no hypothesis attached
look_where: Each line: what belief does it test, and what result would make you stop
why_it_happens: Tactic lists look like plans and require no decision
fix: Every activity gets one hypothesis, one metric and one stop condition. Weak strategy buried under more channels is still weak strategy

tell_vi: Persona bịa: tên, tuổi, sở thích không có nguồn
tell_en: Invented personas with names, ages and hobbies and no source
look_where: Any audience description containing a detail nobody observed
why_it_happens: Personas are a familiar deliverable shape and can be produced without research
fix: One beachhead segment described by situation, job-to-be-done and awareness state, each labelled by where it came from. A fictional 32-year-old marketing manager has misdirected more budget than any bad ad
